title: Kuldra Safespot Quick Run - Runescape Dragonwilds
author: beandon

textNotes.text: This and the entire raid is totally do-able using only a crossbow and various safe spots. I plan to upload a full run showing how I do it. You can also do this in level 8 or even level 7 gear. I will upload videos showing that soon and paste them here in the description. I may even attempt with gear lower than 7. Literally anyone can cheese the raid solo with just a crossbow.

- I usually activate tempest shield during times where I'm exposed running around the arena. That laser move can easily snipe you if you aren't paying attention so I throw it up just in case. Don't trust the crystals and stuff to block you from it, I've been hit through those countless times. Tempest shield will block 100% of the damage. You can dodge roll as well and avoid it with the I-frames bu…

This video is intended for people who are grinding the drops and want a chill low effort way to do this relatively quickly. This is by no means a "speedrun" but I consider it to be the fastest low risk safespottable method. I haven't looked up guides so i'm not claiming that i'm the only one that does it like this, it's just what i've come to through trial and error.
